sources.title: Ecommerce UX Audit: How to Find What's Hurting Your Conversion
sources.takeaway: Checkout and shipping/tax surprises are leading abandonment drivers; audit against heuristics.

sources.title: Ecommerce UX That Converts: 2026 Guide
sources.takeaway: Reviews near add-to-cart, guest checkout, free-shipping progress.

sources.title: GEO for ecommerce: How to get your products cited by AI search engines
sources.takeaway: Complete Product schema, crawlable pages, answer-first copy.

sources.title: AEO/GEO playbook for Shopify brands
sources.takeaway: Brand-owned FAQs, policies, sizing guides are what AI cites.

sources.title: Generative Engine Optimization for Shopify
sources.takeaway: Allow AI crawlers (OAI-SearchBot etc.); claims unverified by OpenAI docs.

sources.title: How To Add Merchant Listing Structured Data
sources.takeaway: Merchant listing requires name/image/offers/price; shippingDetails and hasMerchantReturnPolicy are recommended and act as feed verification, not eligibility gates.

sources.title: We Analyzed 137K Sites: 97% of llms.txt Files Never Get Read
sources.takeaway: 97% of llms.txt files got zero AI-bot requests (May 2026). llms.txt is not a citation lever; keep it only as an agent contract.

sources.title: Does llms.txt matter?
sources.takeaway: 10-site test: 2 sites saw AI traffic gains, 8 unchanged. Google states llms.txt has no effect on Search visibility.

sources.title: Ecommerce GEO in 2026 (Optimize for AI-Powered Search)
sources.takeaway: Answer primary question in first ~200 words; headers as real questions; treat each AI engine as its own visibility environment; track citation rate not CTR.

sources.title: How Google Shopping AI Mode impacts product feeds
sources.takeaway: AI Mode reads the Shopping Graph via Merchant Center with free listings enabled; price/stock/shipping/returns must agree across feed, markup and page.

sources.title: Shopify agent and UCP documentation
sources.takeaway: Shopify serves agents.md, /.well-known/ucp, /api/ucp/mcp and an agentic discovery sitemap by default; merchant job is data accuracy behind them.

sources.title: What ChatGPT Instant Checkout Means for Brands in 2026
sources.takeaway: OpenAI stepped back from in-chat checkout (Mar 2026); Shopify stores reach ChatGPT discovery via Shopify Catalog with no separate feed. Verify Sales channels > Agentic > ChatGPT.
